proration: Scenario: monthly salary 6,300.00; 22 working days in the month; hired on working day 13 (10 working days in service)

ex1.scenario: Resident employee, Form W-4 (2026): Single, Step 2 not checked, no Step 3 or Step 4 entries; weekly wages USD 1,640.00; no pre-tax deductions; year-to-date wages below every cap.
fit: 1i. Adjusted annual wage (line 1g subtracted, Step 2 not checked)
2e. Excess over the bracket floor (STANDARD SINGLE row 4)

ex2.scenario: Nonresident alien employee, Form W-4 (2026) completed per Notice 1392 (Single, NRA, Step 2 not checked); weekly wages USD 1,640.00; first paid in 2026 (Table 2 add-on); no treaty exemption.
fit: 1a. Wages for the computation, including the NRA add-on (Table 2, weekly)
1i. Adjusted annual wage (line 1g subtracted, Step 2 not checked)
2e. Excess over the bracket floor (STANDARD SINGLE row 4)
net: Net pay (the add-on is not paid and not reported)

ex3.scenario: Irregular payment: annual bonus USD 12,400.00 paid separately from regular wages to a resident employee whose 2026 supplemental wages stay below the mandatory-rate threshold and whose year-to-date wages are below the OASDI base and the Additional Medicare threshold; the employer uses the optional flat rate.
